root_cause.text: The original commit added a check that prematurely exited iris_vb2_stop_streaming when the instance state was IRIS_INST_ERROR, which prevented buffer completion and proper teardown, leading to vb2 warnings and inconsistent firmware state.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that the check skipped stop_streaming when the instance was in IRIS_INST_ERROR, causing buffers not to be returned to vb2 and proper teardown to be skipped, leaving firmware inconsistent. The patch diff removes the `if (inst->state == IRIS_INST_ERROR) goto exit;` lines and makes `iris_helper_buffers_done` unconditional, confirming the faulty early return.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove early exit on error state when stopping streaming to ensure cleanup proceeds even if the instance is in error.
intent_record.what: Removed a conditional check that skipped the rest of the function when the instance state is IRIS_INST_ERROR, causing an early jump to the exit label.
intent_record.how: Now, when the instance is in error state, the function will continue executing the remaining code after acquiring the lock, rather than immediately releasing the lock and returning. This ensures that stop streaming operations (e.g., cleanup) are performed even if the instance encountered an error.

intent_record.intent_summary: Always return buffers with error state when stopping streaming, not only on error, and only move instance to error state on actual stop failure.
intent_record.what: Moved iris_helper_buffers_done out of the if (ret) block so it is always called at the exit label, and kept iris_inst_change_state inside the if (ret) block without braces.
intent_record.how: All pending buffers are now returned with VB2_BUF_STATE_ERROR upon stop streaming regardless of whether the stop operation succeeded (ret == 0). The instance error state transition still only occurs on non-zero ret.

grouping_result.intent: Always return buffers with error state when stopping streaming, not only on error, and only move instance to error state on actual stop failure.

consistency_review.core_intent: Modify stop streaming logic to ensure cleanup and buffer return even in error states, and only transition to error state on actual failure.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the root cause by modifying the stop streaming logic to prevent premature exit on error state, ensuring proper cleanup and buffer return, which is exactly what the vulnerability fix requires.
